limits: Each configuration ran once at 120 seconds; default was repeated after candidates. No new long-duration validation or higher-capacity trial.
Source file hashes describe the final candidate; runner safeguards and cancellation evidence were incrementally tightened during the study.
CPU cgroup includes API, worker, EngineCore and helpers, but excludes load/warmup and external clients/monitors. Window includes benchmark bind and cleanup.
GPU utilization covers the whole card including unrelated processes, not theoretical compute occupancy.
Feature device trace is from warmup only, disabled before performance measurement.
Final transcript equality applies only to the two controlled samples; earlier 1e-5 feature tolerance failure is not reversed.
Loopback PC/mobile protocol tests do not replace Android, remote-network or desktop-paste validation.
